theme: Cytosolic nucleic-acid sensing and type I interferon antiviral response
core_role: The shared pathways are the RIG-I/MDA5-MAVS-TBK1/IRF3/IRF7 signalling axis (with TRAF3/TRAF6 adaptors, OTU deubiquitinase regulators and viral evasion of it), which this theme frames as the central cytosolic RNA-sensor relay that converts viral dsRNA detection into type I interferon and NF-kB output, alongside the DNA-sensing, TLR and inflammasome arms in the additional set.

theme: Chromatin assembly, histone acetylation and nucleosome remodelling
core_role: The shared pathways describe nucleosome assembly and chromatin remodelling coupled to replication and repair, which this theme frames as the chromatin-structural substrate that histone acetylation, CHD remodellers and heterochromatin-focus formation act upon.

theme: RB-E2F control of the G1/S cell-cycle transition
core_role: The shared pathways are the E2F transcriptional network that drives G1/S entry, framed here as the output switch released when cyclin D/E-CDK activity inactivates RB1 and blocked by CDK4/6 inhibitors, p21/p27 and RB1-E2F checkpoint control.

theme: NKT and NK cell development and cytokine-driven activation
core_role: The shared pathways cover NKT cell differentiation, proliferation and activation, which this theme frames as one arm of innate-like lymphocyte expansion driven by IL-15 and IL-21 cytokine signalling shared with NK and T cells.

theme: Fanconi anemia interstrand cross-link repair and genome stability
core_role: The shared pathways (DNA stability, checkpoint response, deubiquitination of monoubiquitinated proteins) are framed here as the FANCD2/FANCI monoubiquitination-deubiquitination cycle and checkpoint coupling that govern Fanconi pathway repair of interstrand cross-links during S phase.

theme: Germinal centre B cell maturation into antibody-secreting plasma cells
core_role: The shared pathways describe B cell, germinal-centre, Tfh and plasma-cell differentiation programmes, which this theme frames as the T-dependent humoral response that culminates in class-switched IgG/IgA antibody production.

theme: Epigenetic chromatin regulation by histone modification and remodelling
core_role: The shared pathways are histone acetylation, nucleosome assembly and repair/replication-coupled chromatin remodelling, which this theme frames as the acetylation-and-assembly layer of a broader epigenetic system that also includes histone/DNA methylation, BAF/NuRD/PRC2 complexes, heterochromatin silencing and imprinting.

theme: Rho-family GTPase signalling in actin cytoskeleton remodelling
core_role: The shared pathways describe RAC3 and Rho GTPase activation of WASP/WAVE, Arp2/3 and formins to build lamellipodia, framed here as the actin-nucleation effector output of the many Rho/Rac/CDC42 GTPase cycles in the additional set.

theme: Glutamate, glutamine and aspartate nitrogen metabolism
core_role: The shared pathways are glutamate/glutamine and aspartate interconversion with alpha-ketoglutarate transport, framed here as the central nitrogen-handling and anaplerotic hub linking amino-acid transamination to oxaloacetate, alanine, gluconeogenesis and glutamine/glycine conjugation.

theme: Innate antiviral nucleic-acid sensing and interferon response
core_role: The shared pathways (cytosolic DNA sensing, OAS, IP-10, cellular response to virus and IFN-alpha) are framed here as the interferon-effector and DNA-sensing response that sits downstream of and alongside RIG-I/IRF3 RNA sensing in dendritic cells.

theme: Chromatin assembly and chromosome condensation, including centromeric CENP-A
core_role: The shared pathways describe nucleosome assembly and protein targeting to chromatin, which this theme frames as the chromatin-building basis for mitotic/meiotic chromosome condensation and CENP-A deposition at centromeres.

theme: Vesicle targeting and tethering in ER-Golgi transport
core_role: The shared pathways are vesicle targeting to and within the Golgi from the rough ER, framed here as the destination-recognition step of early secretory traffic that precedes vesicle tethering at the Golgi.

theme: Peroxisomal and mitochondrial acyl-CoA and NADP(H) metabolism
core_role: The shared pathways (NADP+ synthesis, NAD transport, malonyl-/succinyl-/medium-chain acyl-CoA metabolism, peroxisome fission and TYSND1 processing) are framed here as organellar cofactor and acyl-CoA metabolism that supplies NADPH via isocitrate dehydrogenase, with IDH-mutant 2-hydroxyglutarate as the disease link.

theme: Host restriction of retroviruses and viral genome control
core_role: The shared pathways describe APOBEC-mediated cytidine deamination and editing and host suppression of viral genome replication, framed here as the intrinsic antiretroviral restriction (countered by HIV Vif) that acts on the reverse-transcription, integration and latency steps of the viral life cycle in the additional set.

theme: Repulsive axon guidance and neuronal projection wiring
core_role: The shared pathways are Sema3A/plexin signalling via CRMPs, PAK and integrin inhibition driving axon guidance and innervation, framed here as one repulsive-cue system alongside ephrin and L1-family cues that shape growth cone collapse, fasciculation and neuron remodelling.

theme: Fructose, glycerol and pentose sugar metabolism and inborn errors
core_role: The shared pathways cover fructose and glycerol/alditol metabolism and their inherited defects, framed here as hexose and polyol entry routes into glycolysis that sit alongside galactose, pentose-phosphate and glucuronate-xylulose metabolism and their enzyme deficiencies.

theme: UDP-GlcNAc synthesis and nucleotide-sugar supply for glycosylation
core_role: The shared pathways describe hexosamine-pathway synthesis of UDP-N-acetylglucosamine and its defects (GFPT1, ALG14 myasthenic syndromes), framed here as the donor-substrate supply step that feeds Golgi nucleotide-sugar transporters whose defects cause congenital disorders of glycosylation.

theme: Golgi-endosome membrane trafficking and secretion
core_role: The shared pathways describe constitutive secretion, Golgi-to-endosome and plasma-membrane-to-endosome transport and receptor recycling, framed here as the cargo routes of a Golgi-centred trafficking network governed by Rab GTPases, retrograde transport and lysosomal delivery.

theme: Telomere protection, capping and alternative lengthening
core_role: The shared pathways describe telomere packaging, capping, NHEJ protection and ATRX/DAXX-mediated suppression of telomeric recombination, framed here as the protective restraint whose loss permits recombination-based (ALT) telomere maintenance and escape from senescence.

theme: Ammonia detoxification through glutamate/glutamine and the urea cycle
core_role: The shared pathways are glutamate/glutamine and aspartate metabolism with ammonium homeostasis, framed here as the nitrogen-carrying input to the urea cycle, supplying ammonia and aspartate for arginine/citrulline/ornithine metabolism whose enzyme defects cause hyperammonaemia.

theme: Dendritic cell-driven Th1 cytokine immunity
core_role: The shared pathways describe IL-12, IFN-gamma, GM-CSF and Th1 cytokine production, framed here as the Th1-polarising output of activated dendritic cells responding to intracellular pathogens such as protozoa.

theme: Dicarboxylate transport and glutamate-aspartate nitrogen metabolism
core_role: The shared pathways are sodium-coupled and SLC-mediated transport of succinate, citrate and other di/tricarboxylates, framed here as the carrier layer that moves TCA intermediates for the malate-aspartate shuttle and glutamate/glutamine nitrogen metabolism.

theme: Gluconeogenesis and interconnected sugar and pyruvate metabolism
core_role: The shared pathways (alanine and oxaloacetate metabolism, gluconeogenesis) are framed here as the pyruvate/oxaloacetate-to-glucose route that connects amino-acid carbon to the fructose, glycerol, pentose-phosphate and glucuronate pathways of central carbohydrate metabolism.

theme: Axial mesoderm and neural plate formation in early embryo
core_role: The shared pathways describe notochord/axial mesoderm formation, apical constriction and Wnt-TCF modulation, framed here as the midline organiser tissue that patterns the overlying neural plate, floor plate and neural fold.

theme: Pre-mRNA 3'-end processing and RNA maturation and decay
core_role: The shared pathways describe cleavage and polyadenylation of pre-mRNAs, framed here as the 3'-end maturation step within a broader nuclear RNA-processing system including histone mRNA stem-loop processing, splicing, transcription termination, capping and mRNA decay.

theme: TLR adaptor signalling to IKK, NF-kB and TAK1
core_role: The shared pathways describe IRAK1/RIP1-mediated IKK recruitment and canonical NF-kB activation, framed here as the NF-kB arm of MyD88- and TRIF-dependent Toll-like receptor signalling that also drives TAK1, IRF activation and programmed cell death.

theme: microRNA biogenesis, turnover and translational control
core_role: The shared pathways describe pre-miRNA processing, target-directed miRNA decay and miRNA regulation of specific mRNAs (CDH1, CDH11, NPAS4, PD-L1), framed here as the effector and turnover end of the miRNA pathway whose primary and precursor processing steps are the additional set.

theme: Germline, gametogenesis, fertilization and the maternal-to-zygotic transition
core_role: The shared pathways describe maternal mRNA decay, zygotic genome activation, zygotic epigenetic reprogramming and early cleavage/lineage specification, framed here as the post-fertilization handover phase of a reproductive programme that spans gonadal hormones, oogenesis, spermatogenesis, piRNA silencing and fertilization.

theme: MHC class I antigen presentation and NK/cytotoxic recognition
core_role: The shared pathways describe endogenous and class Ib antigen presentation, NK-mediated cytotoxicity and its inhibition, and granzyme killing, framed here as the cytotoxic-recognition outcome of the MHC class I loading and cross-presentation machinery in the additional set.

theme: Pre-mRNA 3'-end processing including histone mRNA
core_role: The shared pathways describe cleavage and polyadenylation of intronless and polyadenylated pre-mRNAs, framed here as the canonical 3'-end route that parallels SLBP-dependent stem-loop processing of histone mRNAs and is coupled to Pol II termination.

theme: Replication stress responses and DNA topology at stalled forks
core_role: The shared pathways describe fork reversal, R-loop processing, DNA topological change and protein-DNA complex disassembly, framed here as the remodelling of DNA structure at stalled replication forks that underlies responses to topoisomerase poisons, hydroxyurea and DNA-protein cross-links.

theme: Death receptor-mediated apoptosis and necroptosis
core_role: The shared pathways describe Fas/TRAIL/TNF death-receptor signalling, caspase-8 activation and its control by c-FLIP, and RIPK1/TRIF necroptosis, framed here as the extrinsic cell-death machinery used in immune killing, T cell deletion and anti-tumour/allograft responses.

theme: Translation termination, ribosome quality control and translation factor modification
core_role: The shared pathways describe translation termination, nonsense-mediated, non-stop and no-go mRNA decay, and diphthamide modification of eEF2, framed here as translational fidelity and surveillance alongside hypusination, hydroxylation and other factor modifications that tune elongation.

theme: Pattern-recognition-driven cytokine responses to fungi and pathogens
core_role: The shared pathways (IL-12, IFN-gamma and GM-CSF production) are framed here as the pro-inflammatory cytokine output of C-type lectin (Dectin-1/2, DC-SIGN) and TLR sensing of fungal and protozoan pathogens, balanced by IL-10 regulatory signalling.

theme: Glycoconjugate biosynthesis and lysosomal glycan catabolism
core_role: The shared pathways describe nucleotide-sugar and sialic acid synthesis, GPI anchor and glycosphingolipid/ganglioside biosynthesis and their defects, framed here as the anabolic half of glycoconjugate turnover whose N-glycan processing and lysosomal degradation (hexosaminidase, sialidase deficiencies) form the additional set.

theme: N-linked glycan processing and maturation
core_role: The shared pathways describe mannose trimming, hybrid/complex N-glycan synthesis, antenna elongation and sialylation, framed here as the Golgi maturation of N-glycans whose eventual lysosomal breakdown appears in the additional set.

theme: tRNA charging, modification and translational fidelity
core_role: The shared pathways describe cytosolic and mitochondrial tRNA aminoacylation and wobble-position tRNA modifications, framed here as the tRNA side of translational accuracy, complemented by wybutosine and translation-factor modifications (diphthamide, hypusine, hydroxylation).

theme: One-carbon folate-methionine cycle and sulfur amino acid metabolism
core_role: The shared pathways describe folate interconversion, methionine synthesis and salvage and SAM/SAH metabolism, framed here as the methyl-donor cycle that feeds homocysteine into transsulfuration, cysteine and glutathione synthesis and selenium metabolism.

theme: Aldehyde/methylglyoxal detoxification and glutathione redox defence
core_role: The shared pathways describe methylglyoxal and aldehyde detoxification and protein repair of glycation damage, framed here as one branch of cellular chemical-stress defence that depends on glutathione synthesis, NADPH regeneration and ROS detoxification.

theme: Cardiomyocyte hypertrophy and cell size control
core_role: The shared pathways describe positive and negative regulation of cardiac muscle adaptation, cardiomyocyte growth, cell size and sarcomere organisation, framed here as the hypertrophic growth response to stress driven by calcineurin-NFAT signalling.

theme: Neurotransmitter transport and synaptic vesicle loading
core_role: The shared pathways describe SLC-mediated neurotransmitter transport, vesicle loading and glycine transporter disease, framed here as part of the uptake and packaging cycle that includes monoamine reuptake transporters and vesicle acidification, with their transporter disorders.

theme: HDL biogenesis and reverse cholesterol transport
core_role: The shared pathways describe ABCA1/apoA-I-driven cholesterol efflux and HDL particle assembly and clearance, framed here as the mechanism of cellular sterol homeostasis by exporting cholesterol to HDL.

theme: Mitochondrial respiratory chain complex assembly
core_role: The shared pathways describe inner-membrane protein insertion and assembly of complexes I and III, framed here as part of oxidative phosphorylation biogenesis together with complex I and ATP synthase assembly.

theme: Protein methylation and translational machinery modification
core_role: The shared pathways describe lysine and arginine methylation of proteins (including p53) and its link to ribosome biogenesis and methionine sensing, framed here as one of the post-translational and tRNA modification systems that tune translation and its fidelity.

theme: Rho-family GTPase cycles and cytoskeletal signalling
core_role: The shared pathways describe the CDC42, RAC3, RHOG and RHOJ GTPase cycles and G-beta-gamma-CDC42 signalling, framed here as core small-GTPase switches whose effectors (formins, IQGAPs) and atypical Rho members regulate actin and focal adhesion dynamics.

theme: Mitotic exit: abscission and nuclear envelope reassembly
core_role: The shared pathways describe mitotic-phase cell-cycle functions and release of sister chromatid cohesion, framed here as the late-mitosis progression that leads into ESCRT-III-mediated nuclear envelope sealing, midbody abscission and cytokinesis.

theme: Kidney development: ureteric bud and metanephric nephrogenesis
core_role: The shared pathways describe intermediate mesoderm, nephric duct, ureteric bud branching and metanephric mesenchyme differentiation, framed here as the reciprocal epithelial-mesenchymal induction that builds nephrons and the collecting system.

theme: Histone and protein methylation and demethylation
core_role: The shared pathways describe histone demethylation, lysine dimethylation and CHD1/2 chromatin remodelling that reads H3K4 methylation, framed here as the chromatin-centred side of a protein methylation system that also targets arginines and non-histone proteins like p53 and RUNX1.
